Name: Simple Skills Extented 2
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]Simple Skills Extented 2[/color][/b][/size]
[size=5][b][color=#F2C879]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]PC 2.37 • Android Experimental 1.19 • Install only one SSE edition.[/size][/center]
[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]✨ Skills & Profession Points[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Extend Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining and Combat independently to 110. Choose 76 professions with 131 ranks and up to 23 points per skill. Native skill values remain capped at 10; SSE tracks extended progression separately. Stored XP activates on character load and food/drink buffs still apply.

Earn 16 points at levels 35–110, one every five levels; four trials and three manuals add seven more. Most professions unlock at 35, advanced professions at 105. Each rank costs one point and requires the preceding rank. You can learn every rank I profession, but cannot maximize everything. Disable learned effects without losing ranks or refunding points.

Abilities include Transplant, Scythe Harvest, Crop Insight, Dash, Timed Guard, Orchard Sweep and Coal Prospector. Forage Helper at Foraging 35 unlocks Marnie’s permanent 25,000g collector and 75,000g Deluxe upgrade with 70 slots. It is unavailable while Simple Forage Helper or an active Essentials helper owns the feature; existing collectors/items remain.[/size]
[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]🏅 Trials, Manuals & Rewards[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Four trials per skill unlock at 25, 50, 70 and 100 and must be completed/claimed in order. Three personal manuals per skill drop through qualifying activities; read one edition before finding the next. A fallback limits bad luck. Early points bank until profession spending opens.

Automatic rewards cover production, quality, fishing, resources and combat. At 110: extra crops/animal produce +30%, seed/fertilizer refunds 20%, matching ground forage +30% and different local seasonal forage 20%. Profession effects are separate. Other benefits include berry reach up to 32 pixels, native casting-energy reduction up to 10% and monster-knockback reduction up to 10%.

Reward Balance scales bonuses 0×–5× in 0.05 steps, default 1×; utility effects have switches. Settings do not grant progression. Optional XP Boost is off by default, selectable 1×–20× in 0.5 steps for newly earned base-skill XP. Existing/Mastery XP and the 110 cap remain unchanged.[/size]
[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]📚 Journal & Controls[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Use the Skills Journal to inspect progression, spend available points, manage trials/manuals and achievements, and adjust settings/text size 100–200%. For outstanding vanilla choices earned at 15/20/25/30, open Perks → skill → Claim earned professions. Use the button, P or controller View/Back; no new sleep/level is needed. From the first perk row, Up focuses Claim.

Controller directions navigate skill tabs and perk controls; A selects and B returns. Purchases require confirmation with Cancel selected first; release A before confirming Learn perk. Escape/right-click also cancel without spending. Navigation supports Snappy Menus on/off and remapped movement.

Skip remaining/all notices dismisses only that night’s SSE notices; keyboard X/controller Y also work. Points/choices remain in the journal. Disable Show level-up reward windows for permanent suppression. Active abilities require assigned keys/controller buttons. Includes twelve language files.[/size]

[size=4][i]Native-rendered profession example; existing progression is retained when upgrading.[/i][/size]
[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]📦 PC Installation & Migration[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Requires PC Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and SMAPI 4.4.0+. Extract SimpleSkillsExtented2 into Mods; GMCM is optional. Back up saves/config before replacing SSE 1, retain the same save and copy config.json into SSE 2. Supported XP, levels and earned professions persist. Level 100 supplies 14 level-earned points;110 supplies 16, before trial/manual points. Do not run SSE 1 removal preparation during migration.[/size]
[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]🤝 Important Integrations[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Supports adapters for Level Extender 3.0.0, Wildroot Chronicles 1.4.5, Farming Level Affects Harvest, Enhanced Rings 1.8.12, Mastery Extended, Walk of Life, Vanilla Plus Professions and Apex Mastery. Other-mod versions matter. Walk of Life and Vanilla Plus Professions remain incompatible with each other.

SSE takes priority over Level Extender’s overlapping five-skill effects while preserving stored records/custom skills. Yield priority preserves native/unrelated crop behaviour. Enhanced Rings and Challenge Bait fish remain separate from SSE additions. Default SSE additions remain at most two fish; reward-strength customization affects only SSE’s additions. SpaceCore/Skill Bars can display progression; Simple Experience Bar 1.7 displays SSE 2 levels/XP.[/size]
[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]🧪 Android Experimental[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Targets game 1.6.15.3 with a compatible SMAPI port exposing API 4.3.2+. Desktop compatibility checks and 837 native-reference resolutions are recorded; physical Android loader, touch and controller gameplay remain unverified.

Extract SimpleSkillsExtented2Android into Mods. Back up saves and retain config.json. Checks-only mode defaults on: set AndroidCompatibilityChecksOnly=false and restart to opt into gameplay; startup checks must pass. Inspect android-compatibility.json if blocked. Existing opt-in choices persist.

Open the journal using its HUD book button. Trials/manuals support swipes and tap-to-claim; dedicated ability touch buttons are not included. Farmhand transplant requests are disabled on Android. Include android-compatibility.json with reports. Generative AI assisted code, translations and page content.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]🐛 Bug Reports & Suggestions[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]For bugs, include the mod/edition, game and SMAPI versions, platform, expected versus actual result, reproduction steps and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url]. Add a screenshot or short video if useful. For suggestions, explain the change and how it would help.[/size]
